originalTitle: 3 Reasons to Avoid TFC and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: Since February 2026, Truist Financial has been in a holding pattern, posting a small return of 0.9% while floating around $52.67. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 13.1% gain during that period.
content:
Since February 2026, Truist Financial has been in a holding pattern, posting a small return of 0.9% while floating around $52.67. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500's 13.1% gain during that period.

Is now the time to buy Truist Financial, or should you be careful about including it in your portfolio? Check out our in-depth research report to see what our analysts have to say, it's free .

Why Do We Think Truist Financial Will Underperform?

We're sitting this one out for now. Here are three reasons we avoid TFC, plus one stock we'd rather own.

1. Net Interest Income Points to Soft Demand

Our experience and research show the market cares primarily about a bank's net interest income growth as one-time fees are considered a lower-quality and non-recurring revenue source.

Truist Financial's net interest income has grown at a 1.9% annualized rate over the last five years, much worse than the broader banking industry. Its growth was driven by an increase in its outstanding loans as its net interest margin, which represents how much a bank earns in relation to its outstanding loan book, was flat throughout that period.

2. Projected Net Interest Income Growth Is Slim

Forecasted net interest income by Wall Street analysts signals a company's potential. Predictions may not always be accurate, but accelerating growth typically boosts valuation multiples and stock prices while slowing growth does the opposite.

Over the next 12 months, sell-side analysts expect Truist Financial's net interest income to rise by 1.7%.

We track the long-term change in earnings per share (EPS) because it highlights whether a company's growth is profitable.

Sadly for Truist Financial, its EPS and revenue declined by 1.6% and 1.2% annually over the last five years. We tend to steer our readers away from companies with falling revenue and EPS, where diminishing earnings could imply changing secular trends and preferences. If the tide turns unexpectedly, Truist Financial's low margin of safety could leave its stock price susceptible to large downswings.

We cheer for all companies supporting the economy, but in the case of Truist Financial, we'll be cheering from the sidelines. With its shares underperforming the market lately, the stock trades at 1.1× forward P/B (or $52.67 per share). This valuation tells us a lot of optimism is priced in - we think there are better opportunities elsewhere. Let us point you toward the Amazon and PayPal of Latin America .

chineseTitle: 避免 TFC 的 3 个理由和值得购买的 1 只股票
chineseSummary: 自 2026 年 2 月以来，Truist Financial 一直处于持有模式，回报率为 0.9%，徘徊在 52.67 美元左右。该股同期涨幅也低于标准普尔 500 指数 13.1% 的涨幅。
chineseContent:
自 2026 年 2 月以来，Truist Financial 一直处于持有模式，回报率为 0.9%，徘徊在 52.67 美元左右。该股同期涨幅也低于标准普尔 500 指数 13.1% 的涨幅。

现在是购买 Truist Financial 的好时机，还是应该谨慎地将其纳入您的投资组合？查看我们的深入研究报告，看看我们的分析师怎么说，它是免费的。

为什么我们认为 Truist Financial 会表现不佳？

我们暂时搁置这一问题。以下是我们避开 TFC 的三个原因，以及我们宁愿持有的一只股票。

1.净利息收入表明需求疲软

我们的经验和研究表明，市场主要关心银行的净利息收入增长，因为一次性费用被认为是一种质量较低的非经常性收入来源。

Truist Financial 的净利息收入在过去五年中以年化 1.9% 的速度增长，远低于整个银行业。其增长是由未偿还贷款的增加推动的，因为其净息差（代表银行相对于未偿还贷款账面的收入）在此期间持平。

2.预计净利息收入增长缓慢

华尔街分析师预测的净利息收入表明了公司的潜力。预测可能并不总是准确的，但加速增长通常会推高估值倍数和股价，而放缓增长则相反。

卖方分析师预计未来 12 个月 Truist Financial 的净利息收入将增长 1.7%。

我们跟踪每股收益（EPS）的长期变化，因为它突显了公司的增长是否有利可图。

可悲的是，Truist Financial 的每股收益和收入在过去五年中每年分别下降 1.6% 和 1.2%。我们倾向于引导读者远离收入和每股收益下降的公司，这些公司的收益下降可能意味着长期趋势和偏好的变化。如果形势意外逆转，Truist Financial 的安全边际较低，可能导致其股价容易大幅下跌。

我们为所有支持经济的公司欢呼，但就 Truist Financial 而言，我们将在场外欢呼。由于其股价最近表现不佳，该股的市盈率为 1.1 倍（即每股 52.67 美元）。这一估值告诉我们，很多乐观情绪已被定价——我们认为其他地方有更好的机会。让我们向您介绍拉丁美洲的亚马逊和贝宝。

我们会购买而不是 Truist Financial 的股票

当您在这里时：排名前九的跑赢市场的股票。最好的股票不会只跑赢市场一次。他们又这么做了。又来了。强劲的收入增长、不断增长的自由现金流、资本回报率让他们在竞争中遥遥领先。市场已经给这些企业带来了回报。
